lines.explanation: The task is read-only (identify a channel), so it is active regardless of resolution mode. The agent correctly located Priya's CUDA-root-cause message in #core-infra (msg 1706001931.000000), retrieved its reactions via reactions.get, and correctly identified the 🎉 (tada) reactor as U04OMER23 (Omer Narwhal). It then searched for messages authored by Omer and found exactly one match, in #random (C02EFGH5678), which matches the card's resolved referent set. The final response correctly reports #random as the channel, satisfying the sole-obligation binding of message/user/reaction to author's channel.
